Q: What kind of evidence should I use in a nursing assignment?

The use of quality academic sources in the writing of a nursing assignment is wholly necessary in the UK. Suggested pieces of evidence for an assignment are:

  • Peer-reviewed journal articles via CINAHL, PubMed, or Medline
  • NMC Codes, NICE Guidelines, WHO publications
  • Systematic reviews, clinical trials, practice frameworks
  • Creds of government or NHS report

Do not use non-scholarly things like blogs, Wikipedia, or any old materials. Try to publish all materials in the last five years. https://cided.espoch.edu.ec/
